job_title:
Data Scientist, Tempus Discover
Data Scientist, Tempus Discover with verification
points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving document-level QA reliability and extraction accuracy for clinical and genomic data.
\item Built hybrid retrieval workflows combining dense embeddings and BM25 search to efficiently process structured and unstructured data for patient cohort identification.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess data quality, accuracy, and relevance across hundreds of examples, ensuring production-ready reliability.
\item Introduced batched query extraction, reducing LLM calls by 80% and enabling scalable analytical workflows on multi-modal healthcare datasets.
\item Containerized and deployed AI/ML solutions using Docker and AWS, ensuring reproducible and scalable pipelines for clinical ML applications.
\item Collaborated cross-functionally with Data Science, Research, and Engineering teams to standardize data documentation, communicate technical insights, and support academic research partners.
